column2: In-depth reading: how do I link the AI’s text to the lines of the image?
column3: When you keep the text of “🔬 In-depth reading (AI)” (“Put into the text” or “Keep this one”), the app splits the page into lines and links each line of the text to its line on the image, like “✍️ Read handwriting (fast)”: coloured areas; clicking a line lights up its area, clicking an area selects its line. The splitting comes from “✍️ Read handwriting (fast)” if it is installed (it also gives a text per line, which helps pair the lines), otherwise from a simple splitting of the image (the enhanced image if “Read and export the enhanced image” is ticked). A line cut in two by the AI, or two lines stuck together, are found; notes written vertically in the margin stay apart. A line linked without certainty is grey with ❔ in its note: check it. A line that is not on the image gets no area: nothing is made up. “↶ Undo” removes the areas placed. “▤ Link the lines to the image” does the same afterwards, on text already entered or typed by hand; the box of the same name, in the window with the two readings, lets you skip it. Suggested corrections (🪄) also work on this text, in the window with the two readings and in the workshop, with the same settings (careful at first) and “↶ Undo”.
